Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting certain amateur radio repeaters from leasehold excise taxes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting certain amateur radio repeaters fromleasehold excise taxes; and adding a new section to chapter 82.29A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.29A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) All leasehold interests in property used for the placement ofamateur radio repeaters that are made available for use by, or are usedin support of, a public agency in the event of an emergency orpotential emergency to which the agency is, or may be, a qualifiedresponder, are exempt from tax under this chapter. (2) For purposes of this act, "amateur radio repeater" means anelectronic device that receives a weak or lowlevel amateur radiosignal and retransmits it at a higher level or higher power, so thatthe signal can cover longer distances without degradation, and is usedby amateur radio operators possessing a valid license issued by thefederal communications commission.
